description: Multi-VM training scenario delivering 6 Ubuntu LTS hosts (1 trainer + 5 students) pre-provisioned with the Docker baseline (docker, docker compose, zsh, curl, git, jq, vim, network utils) on vmbr142, plus the kunai-project ecosystem repos pre-cloned in alice's home on every VM. Trainer hostname admin-trainer-kunai (VMID 1104, IP 192.168.142.104) ; students student-kunai-01..05 (VMIDs 1105..1109, IPs 192.168.142.105..109). Single in-VM user alice on every VM, project convention (matches demo_lab and the blank scenarios). Cloned from template VMID 9232 (template-vm-medium-02-8g-64g, 2cpu/8gb/64gb) created by this scenario's 01_templates-bootstrap/ (idempotent : skipped if already present from another scenario that builds the same medium template). Only SSH (port 22) is opened by this scenario.
